完整会议：处理突发问题

综合使用澄清、建议、风险说明和行动确认，应对会议中突然出现的问题。

02 / 05

分段听懂

情节 01

确定影响范围

TTim

We've got a problem with the demo account. It worked this morning, but now I get an error after signing in. The customer call starts in twenty minutes.

演示账号出了问题。今天上午还能用，现在登录后就报错。客户通话二十分钟后开始。

DDacey

Is it just our account, or is the whole ? I can still open the public page. Before we change the meeting, let's work out exactly what we can't show.

只是我们的账号有问题，还是整个服务都不可用了？我还能打开公开页面。调整会议之前，先弄清楚到底哪些内容无法展示。

TTim

Only the demo account, as far as we know. Support is checking, but there's no yet. The saved screenshots are fine; the live dashboard isn't available.

据我们目前所知，只是演示账号。支持团队正在检查，但还没有恢复时间。保存的截图没问题，现场看板目前不可用。

情节 02

选择备用方案

DDacey

Could we use the screenshots as a ? The customer's main question is how their weekly review would work. We can explain those steps without a live account, as long as we're clear that we're showing a saved example.

我们能把截图用作备用方案吗？客户主要想知道每周评审要怎么操作。即使没有现场账号，也能说明步骤，只要明确说这是保存的示例。

TTim

Yes, but they also wanted to try changing the themselves. We can't do that with screenshots. I'd suggest keeping today's call and offering a short recorded demo afterwards if the account isn't back in time.

可以，不过他们还希望亲自试一下修改日期范围。截图没办法做到这一点。我建议保留今天的通话，并在会后提供一段简短的演示录像，如果账号没及时恢复的话。

DDacey

That seems reasonable. Let's keep the call as planned. I'll mention the account issue at the start, then use the screenshots to the main steps. We shouldn't promise a recording today until we know when access will return.

这样比较合理。按计划进行通话吧。我会在开头说明账号问题，然后用截图讲解主要步骤。知道什么时候恢复访问之前，不应该承诺今天就能给录像。

情节 03

安排现场协作

TTim

Agreed. I'll stay in touch with support during the call. If the account comes back, I'll message you rather than . You can choose when to switch to the live view.

同意。通话时我会继续和支持团队联系。如果账号恢复，我会发消息给你，而不是打断你。你可以选择何时切换到现场画面。

DDacey

Can you check the screenshots while I update the opening slide? Please make sure no customer names are visible. Put them in order, so we're not searching during the call.

我修改开场幻灯片的时候，你能检查一下截图吗？请确保没有可见的客户姓名。把它们按顺序排好，免得通话时临时找。

情节 04

确认职责和检查点

TTim

I'll do that now and put them in the meeting folder. Let's check in again five minutes before the call. By then, we should know whether we're using the live account or starting with the backup.

我现在就做，放进会议文件夹。我们在通话前五分钟再确认一次。到那时应该能知道，是用现场账号，还是先用备用方案。

DDacey

I'll explain the issue; you check the files and account. If we need a recording, we'll confirm the timing after the call. We can still have a useful meeting without overpromising.

我负责解释问题；你检查文件和账号。如果需要录像，就在通话后确认时间。我们仍然可以开展有价值的会议，而不作出过多承诺。
